description: EKU is listed in HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS even though its value is not inspected. This is correct: RFC 5280 §6.1 path validation does not require inspecting EKU values. Rejecting a cert with critical EKU as UnhandledCriticalExtension would break TLS server cert validation (CA/B Forum requires critical EKU on many cert types). A contributor might suggest removing EKU from the handled set to 'be stricter' — this would be wrong.
title: Decision: OID_EXTENDED_KEY_USAGE in HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS is deliberate and correct
